plan: With a private value of $28, I want to bid strategically. Since this is a second-price sealed bid auction, I should bid close to, but not exactly at, my true value. Other rational bidders will also try to maximize profit. I'll bid slightly below my true value to create a buffer that protects potential profit. A bid around $25-$26 seems optimal - high enough to likely win, but low enough to potentially generate positive earnings if the competing bids are lower.

With a private value of $16, I want to maximize potential profit. Since this is a second-price sealed bid auction, my optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my true value. Other rational bidders will likely do the same. I'll bid $15.9 - this is close to my true value but leaves room for potential profit if others bid lower. This strategy balances revealing my high valuation while protecting against overpaying.

With a high private value of $19, I want to win, but not overpay. Since this is a second-price sealed bid auction, I'll bid strategically below my full value. Other rational bidders will also bid below their value. I'll aim to bid around $15-$16 - high enough to likely win, but not so high that I risk losing money if my value is only $19. This allows some buffer against the second-highest bid.
